body: TestAssertNoDownload_TC006_ChangeLeavesApplicationUntouched goes against the technical specification. The spec maps TC-006 to a repository diff check plus the gates, not to a unit test in this package. The test is also brittle: it walks ../../../cmd and ../../../internal and fails if any non-_test.go file imports amazontest. A test-support package elsewhere (for example a future internal/httpapi/httpapitest helper file) could import amazontest without changing the server binary, and this test would still fail. A text search for the import string also does not show what actually reaches the binary. To prove that the server does not depend on amazontest, use `go list -deps ./cmd/...` in the gate/repository check, or drop the scan and rely on the TC-006 diff check as specified.

The amazontest unit tests check that internal/service/zz_scratch_docs_test.go is absent (issue #208, FR-TEST-HYG-003). This has nothing to do with the amazontest package or with issue #232. It also ties this package's tests to an unrelated file path through ../../service. The technical specification lists the issue #208 cases as repository checks ('unchanged record'). Remove this assertion from the package test and keep it as the repository check the spec describes.

The test case mapping names the tests TestAssertNoDownloadFailsOnUnreadableFile, TestAssertNoDownloadReportsUnreadableDownloadByName, TestDownloadFileIgnoresRemovedFile, TestAssertNoDownloadJudgesReadableFiles and TestAssertNoDownloadPassesOnBrowserProfile (lines 75-79). The test file declares TestAssertNoDownload_TC001_FailsOnUnreadableFile, TestAssertNoDownload_TC002_..., TestDownloadFile_TC003_..., TestAssertNoDownload_TC004_... and TestAssertNoDownload_TC005_... instead, plus a TC-006 unit test that the mapping does not mention. Update the mapping to the real names so a reader can run them with -run.
